result.summary: Identified minor UI issues including a missing navigation icon, generic vector placeholders, and text truncation.

issues.description: The 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation bar lacks an icon above its label.
issues.suggestion: Add the appropriate icon graphics above the 'Orders' label.

issues.description: Restaurant listing cards display vector graphic illustrations instead of food photos.
issues.suggestion: Replace vector artwork with actual food imagery.

issues.description: Card titles are truncated early on horizontally scrolling cards.
issues.suggestion: Optimize font sizing or text wrapping for compact card layouts.
